culture.text: Founded in 2017 and based at an Innovation Hub in Amsterdam, it tests new sustainable materials and recycling methods together with brands and suppliers.
Staff often studied sustainability, fashion design or business at UvA, Politecnico di Milano, VU, Amsterdam Fashion Institute or RSM.
Its work is research-heavy, for example examining 8,280 garments at sorting sites in four EU countries, Ghana and Pakistan.

open.text: Fashion for Good B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: It launched a project to benchmark recycled cotton quality.
It launched an industry project to benchmark alternatives to PFAS 'forever chemicals'.
Interloop joined Fashion for Good as an innovation partner.

worth_knowing.text: Wendy Woods was named Chair of the Fashion for Good BV board.
